entries.author: PHOTIUS CONSTANTINOPOLITANUS PATRIARCHA
entries.title: Lectori (note on the Epistola ad Ecclesiam Antiochenam from TOMOS XAPAS, to be added at the end of the tome)
entries.note: Printed on the Elenchus page itself (line 213), so it carries no column. The note promises Photius's Epistola ad Ecclesiam Antiochenam 'ad calcem hujus tomi' with Latin interpretation; searches for ANTIOCHEN, XAPA, Sgouta, 'archiepiscopal' found no such text in cols 989-1013 (index) of the OCR.

problems: Elenchus lists only the five main works (plus the Lectori note); sub-items are in the Ordo, not entered.
Elenchus columns for Mystagogia, Carmina, Epistolae are OCR-garbled (203, $15, SRI); body and Ordo settle them.
The Epistola ad Ecclesiam Antiochenam promised by the Lectori note was not found in the OCR.
Page-number lines near cols 575 and 547 are garbled (515/916, 541), placed by neighbouring anchors and the Ordo.
Ordo-only apparatus not entered: Index rerum et verborum analyticus (Ordo col 991).
